subject: general
question: As per the ‘World Population Prospects 2019 Report’, India's population is expected to exceed the population of China by the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2027**__.

__
 
• **As per the ‘World Population Prospects 2019 Report’, India's population is expected to exceed the population of China by the year 2027**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Population Prospects 2019 Report:**

 
 
• It is s published by the Population Division of the UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs.
 
• The report says:
 
 
• The world population is projected to grow to 2 billion people within the next 30 years, rising from 7.7 billion currently to 9.7 billion in 2050, in line with a United Nations replacement report launched today.
 
• The world population will reach its peak in the 21st century, only 11 billion.
 
• India, Nigeria, Pakistan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, the United Republic of Tanzania, Indonesia, Egypt and the United States will account for more than half of the estimated growth of the world's population between 2019 and 2050.
 
• According to the report, the population of India is expected to exceed the population of China by the year 2027.​
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations:**

 
 
• The UNO was formed on **24 October 1945**.
 
• At present, 193 countries are members of the UN.
 
• **South Sudan** is the latest and the **193rd member** to join the UN in **2011**.
 
• The **UN Charter **came into force on October 24, 1945, when the Governments of** China, France, the UK, the Soviet Union, and the USA** and a majority of other counties had ratified it.
 
• The **headquarters of the UN** is situated in **New York (USA)**.
